raw_rgb: uint8 or finite floating point in [0,1]; no clipping, registration, filling or recoloring of predictions

calibration.palette: Reuse existing palette_masks and validate_calibration unchanged. Gray prototype [119,136,153]/255; alpha [0.40,1.25], colour residual<=0.12. Blue thresholds remain b>.60,r<.45,g<.65,b-max(r,g)>.25.
calibration.new_calibration: No threshold fitting. Optional identity check renders only the18 seen canonical truth shapes, pusher(40,40),body-origin(256,256),angle0; zero physics steps and no predictions.

primary.object_error: 1 minus unaligned visible gray-object mask intersection-over-union; computed independently of blue pusher.
primary.raw_contour: Symmetric mean nearest-boundary Euclidean distance using unchanged legacy _contour_distance, reported in image pixels and world pixels; no alignment.
primary.object_rgb_roi: binary_dilation(last_gray OR true_gray, square3x3,iterations2) AND NOT binary_dilation(last_blue OR true_blue,square3x3,iterations1); fixed by LAST/TRUE only, never by prediction.
primary.combined_foreground_rgb_roi: binary_dilation(last_gray OR true_gray OR last_blue OR true_blue,square3x3,iterations2); separate auxiliary RGB MAE.
primary.pusher_rgb_roi: binary_dilation(last_blue OR true_blue,square3x3,iterations2), independent of prediction.
primary.pusher_metrics: Separate raw blue-mask IoU,error1-IoU,centroid distance and fixed-pusher-ROI RGB MAE; never merged into object fit criterion.

failure_policy.denominators: Always18 TRAIN and36 development, in frozen metadata order. No failed/empty/nonfinite rows may be removed.
failure_policy.empty_object: raw IoU0/error1; raw contour penalty96*sqrt(2) imagepx. Other independently measurable metrics remain reported.
failure_policy.contour_or_position_unavailable_penalty_: 96*sqrt(2), with explicit failure/unavailable reason; no finite-only primary mean.
failure_policy.empty_roi: RGB MAE1 with explicit empty truth-defined ROI flag, never omitted.
failure_policy.shape_ambiguity: Visible components/holes/area/fragments reported even when old deformation assessment is unknown. Occlusion or viewport-border touch retains unknown; unknown is never shape-pass.
failure_policy.clipping: Report gray/blue predicted and truth border-touch separately. Raw RGB cannot determine unobserved content outside the viewport; keep that limitation explicit.
failure_policy.legacy_exceptions: Catch score_rgb exceptions as named row fields; do not drop the row or its primary penalties.

shape_and_auxiliary.topology: Unchanged legacy _topology with minimum_component_pixels2,8-connected foreground/4-connected background. Report components,holes,extra/missing fragments,tiny-fragment pixels and relative area error.
shape_and_auxiliary.aligned_shape: Unchanged align_masks_for_score only as offline metric; predicted raw RGB is never transformed or replaced.
shape_and_auxiliary.registration_grid: Centroid translation; global rotation10degrees, local1degree refinement, then angles best+-1 and translation offsets[-1,-.5,0,.5,1] imagepixels with nearest-neighbor rasterization.
shape_and_auxiliary.motion_qualification: Visible-mask apparent registration only, with shape symmetry/occlusion ambiguity. Grid spacing is not subdegree or subpixel pose accuracy. Auxiliary, not the fit target.
shape_and_auxiliary.legacy_deformation: Report unchanged shape_deformation_failure together with assessable/unknown counts and reasons, never a finite-only all-samples pass.
shape_and_auxiliary.privileged_truth_full_masks: Optional unoccluded LAST/TRUE alpha masks thresholded at the same calibration minimum_alpha=.40; report predicted-visible versus true-full IoU and visible truth fraction separately. They are offline truth diagnostics only; they never reconstruct or repair prediction, alter raw-visible primary IoU, or turn legacy occlusion-unknown into a pass.
shape_and_auxiliary.static_drift: For development H1-near_static windows report prediction-versus-LAST object1-IoU,gray centroid displacement and shape outcomes. No requirement to beat zero-error hold.

train_dynamic_target.hold_zero_error: Relative improvement unavailable and target not passed.
train_dynamic_target.interpretation: Visible-motion18-sample fitting diagnostic only, not generalization or full acceptance; shape failures/unknown remain separately visible. Failure within bounded fit does not disprove GPC.

development_report.comparison: Moving: paired raw object-error wins/improvement versus hold/frozen. Static: drift/shape, no beat-zero-hold requirement. Intermediate separately.

gallery.order: All frozen TRAIN18 then development36 windows in supplied metadata order; never rank by outcome
gallery.invalid_display: Explicit INVALID placeholder, raw original array retained; no clipped repaired prediction

resource_scope: CPU offline scoring/render only; no model, inference, GPU, optimizer or training iterator. Original raw NPZ files retained and SHA-bound.
